variants.prompt: A striking young woman with rich chestnut hair swept into an effortless updo, bright emerald eyes smoldering with intensity, sits on the edge of a plush hotel bed in a lavish penthouse suite. Her smooth porcelain skin glows under the warm, moody blue light of a night lamp. She exudes dominance in a tight, crimson corset, the lacing emphasizing her toned physique, paired with black lace panties and stiletto heels. A silver Celtic necklace rests against her throat as she crosses her arms, her gaze commanding the space.
